inspected_claims.finding: Correct: outward solid-to-liquid n_f downward when liquid below; -p I n_f then upward. Exposed compressive stress is distinct from opening of another interface.
Correct conditional two-sheet model. Intermediate transmitted traction is opposite on each sheet and unknown until contact/bond closure. Fully bonded laminate caveat explicit.

Bending and tension energy derivatives match the transient operator, with clamped displacement and slope variations eliminating boundary work. Applied pulse impulse retains reaction impulses before the free-jump approximation.

Regular clamped shape, volume, bending energy, negative reservoir-inclusive potential and fixed-pressure G correct. Fixed-volume G also correct, with opposite crack-radius trend. Controls are not reused as transient jet solutions.
Triangular monotonic work equals Tmax*deltac/2; positive softening interval condition correct. Compression, unloading/history and mixed mode remain explicitly unresolved.
Actual net impulse implies 0.672378829 m/s and 0.526688683 nJ; low-Gamma release-plus-KE is 5.526688683 nJ. 0.50 m/s and 0.29125 nJ are expressly minimum requirements.
Global work/momentum screens are necessary and conditional; crack coverage, competing release, damage, rotation, landing and reset not claimed solved.
Reviewed signs, model restrictions, load-control contrast, corrected numbers, zero-initial-energy premise and necessary-versus-sufficient statements agree in EN/ZH. No material contradiction found.

B_alpha,beta=D[(1-nu)w_alpha,beta+nu delta_alpha,beta Laplacian w] contracts to D biharmonic w. claims.detail: Tensor coefficient, summed bulk derivatives, both surface terms, signs and fixed-clamp elimination correct.
All four power expressions dimensionally W and correct under constant parameters, fixed clamp and stationary donor reference.
Derivative compliance handles zero pressure and retains the correct stored and source-inclusive potentials.
Explicit in both languages; moving donor requires its own momentum and power balances.

With stiffness, pretension and cohesion set to zero, the plate law reduces to m_A wddot = p_load. Chinese now means free acceleration of unconstrained areal mass, matching the English plate limit and avoiding an incorrect fluid free-surface interpretation.
